note: Per-package statement coverage floors, measured in the CI runner. Regenerate with `go run ./tools/coveragefloor -update` after a coverage run. A package without tests carries an exclusion and the reason it has none. A package fails when it falls more than 0.05 points below its floor.

exclusions.cmd/sysc-plugin-weather: a plugin host wrapper. The code it starts lives in plugins/reference/weather, which has its own tests.
exclusions.internal/platform/wayland/backgroundeffe: a generated protocol binding. The file is written by go-wayland-scanner from protocols/ext-background-effect-v1.xml, so a floor here would measure generated code rather than this tree's own work.

exclusions.tools/emojigen: an authoring tool that regenerates internal/emoji/emoji.tsv from pinned Unicode and CLDR data. It is never run by go build, so there is nothing for the suite to cover.
